A '''human prisoner''' of the [[Galactic Empire]] served time at the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison facility]] on [[Narkina 5]], working the night shift<ref name="NL!" /> at [[Level 5 (Narkina 5)|Level 5]], Room 2 at table 2.<ref name="N5">{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}}</ref> They were present when the day and night shift prisoners were switching places and news spread that a hundred men spread across two shifts on Level 2 had been electrocuted. When a [[Unidentified night shift prisoner 1|fellow night shift prisoner]] stated how many men were killed, the other prisoner responded with "I heard nothing."<ref name="NL!" />
